verdict.rationale: Vanta documents token-authenticated REST APIs for headless automation: listing tests, documents, policies and evidence, bulk actions, and pushing custom resources. It also ships type-safe SDKs and registrable webhooks, so automation scripts can drive it without the UI. However, nothing shows a first-party CLI, CI integration (e.g. a pipeline action or plugin), or service-account guidance, and the SDKs are documented only for the Auditor API. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI/pipeline integration, documented non-interactive/service-account auth for CI, SDK coverage beyond the Auditor API, independent hands-on corroboration.
